text.p: Supervalu Inc said Tuesday that Jeffrey Girard, executive vice president and chief financial officer, has resigned, effective at the end of July.
Supervalu said Girard helped bring the company through several successful financial and technology transformations in his six-year tenure.
Girard has informed management that he intends to search for opportunities in a general management role or possibly launch an entrepreneurial venture, it said.

Supervalu is a large food distributor and the 13th largest food retailer in the U.S. As of February 22, it served about 4,300 food stores in 48 states and 611 limited assortment stores. It also operated 322 food retail stores.
